description: This file contains the implementation of a database driver for the ADOdb library to interface with the Advantage Database Server (ADS). It defines classes for connection management and recordset handling specific to ADS, including methods for establishing connections, executing queries, managing transactions, and retrieving metadata.

classes.name: ADODB_ads
classes.description: Represents a database connection to the Advantage Database Server, managing connection setup, transaction control, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ads
classes.description: Represents a result set retrieved from ADS, allowing iteration over query results, field access, and data fetching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the connection or recordset object.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the ADS database using provided data source name, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the ADS database.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server version and description information.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for autogenerated IDs.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops the sequence table.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new ID from the sequence table.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables and views.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a table.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for columns of a table.

methods.name: MetaColumnNames
methods.description: Retrieves column names for a table.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution, possibly for parameter binding.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a prepared or direct SQL query, returns a result identifier.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in a table with binary data.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.
